Smallest admissible sets, singleton and lower-rank cases, zero beta parameters, diagonal endpoint pairs, and the dimension-zero induction base present no counterexample or boundary defect. The kernel decomposition is exact and gives positive semidefiniteness for all allowed parameters. Expanding the two quadratic forms verifies identity (6), and both discarded terms are nonnegative under the stated assumptions, so the induction proves (5) for every specified monotone function. Convexity and D = P intersect Z^n establish the full bijection with equal-parity ordered endpoint pairs. The log-affine identity and triangle-inequality direction in (8) are correct, and the kernel includes precisely the allowed coordinate pairs. Applying (5) to the downward-closed indicator gives the claimed lower bound on R. The halfspace midpoint argument and the oriented-displacement count, including v = 0, prove tau_w(J) >= S_J/2 against the original table, and hence the asserted inequalities for A. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
